kills.property: Each recipient's reward can only be withdrawn once: after a first-payout call sequence, a repeated withdrawReward for the same recipient must pay nothing extra, so the contract's total outflow is exactly the single reward amount.
kills.change_summary: Delete the zeroing of rewardsForA[recipient], so the balance is not reset before withdrawal.

kills.property: For any fresh recipient, getFirstWithdrawalBonus(recipient) succeeds because the reentrancy lock is released after each withdrawal; in the mutant the lock is never released, so a bonus claim for a second fresh recipient reverts inside withdrawReward.
kills.change_summary: Delete `_locked = false;` so the lock is never released and any subsequent withdrawReward call reverts, changing the observable end state.

kills.property: For every recipient and caller, once getFirstWithdrawalBonus(recipient) completes on a contract holding exactly the 100-wei reward, the 100 wei must have been transferred out so that address(c).balance becomes 0; the mutant sends 0 wei, leaving the contract still holding 100 wei, violating the rule.
kills.change_summary: Replace the amount computation with `uint amountToWithdraw = 0;` so no value is ever sent.

kills.property: For any contract that claims the first-withdrawal bonus and re-enters at least twice, the reentrancy guard must make the outer getFirstWithdrawalBonus revert; deleting '_locked = true' lets the nested claims succeed and the outer call complete instead.
kills.change_summary: Delete `_locked = true;` so the reentrancy guard no longer blocks reentrant calls, exposing different end-state values.
